_comment: Vercel project identities (not secrets). The public site may build for Vercel Production only in publicSite, from main of repository, and never in demo. Changing these requires a reviewed pull request. publicSite.projectId is the splitpost project's ID (Settings, General, Project ID), as Vercel reported it on PR #39; confirm it in the dashboard. Recording it does not enable Production: CREVANT_PRODUCTION_SITE_APPROVED=true must also be set in that project. memberApp is the member app project (app.splitpost.ca, pilot milestone M1), created by the founder on 2026-11-19; projectId is its ID from Settings, General, Project ID. Recording it does not enable Production: CREVANT_MEMBER_APP_APPROVED=true must also be set in that project, and the build must be a Git build of main.
